notes: Pencil page 11; no manuscript page number. The leaf proposes a profinite envelope of an abstract category satisfying (*). It specifies locally compact separated Hom spaces, continuity of composition, profinite automorphism groups, and open automorphism-group orbits. A marginal qualification reads “devrait” followed by a compressed, still doubtful “suffire”. In (17), the group labels are below the wedges; the comparison between the two formulas is an upward arrow bearing a separate wavy isomorphism mark, not just a rotated equals sign. The source claims an ad-hoc composition, unique by continuity and extension from C_0. Existence of the construction and the equivalence of the two contracted-product presentations are not independently proved here.

checks.statement: A continuous extension from a dense subset into a Hausdorff space is unique.
checks.outcome: Checked: the equalizer of two continuous maps to a Hausdorff target is closed; if it contains the dense original locus, it is the whole domain. This verifies the uniqueness principle, conditional on density and the asserted construction.
